page.layout: One column of text with Arabic and Latin lines mixed, running head "NOTÆ." at top, printed page number 219 at top right. Marginal notes in the right margin: "c. de Nodamianis.", "lin. 4.", "l. 5.". Catchword "creatione." at the lower right. Signature "F.3" at the foot left.

main_text.p: الخلق في الاخرة in confessione ipsorum, Christum eum esse qui homines judicaturus sit die ultimo, & de verbi aeterni incarnatione, ipsissimis quae apud authorem nostrum habentur verbis. alibi autem (ne religionis Christianae mysteria intellexisse eum putemus) scribit ipsum asseruisse ان للخلق خالقين احدهماc. de Nodamianis. قديم وهو الباري تعالي والثاني محدث وهو المسيح Creaturis duos esse creatores, quorum unum aeternus sit, nempe Deus excelsus, alter de novo ortus, nempe Christus: vel (ut Author Al Mawakef, & Ebnol Kassai, للعالم الهارن قديم هو الله تعالي ومحدث هو المسيح) Mundo duos esse Deos, aeternum qui sit Deus, supra omnia excelsus, & novum, qui sit Christus, &c. Miras praeterea sententiarum ineptias ipsi impingit. Vir, ingenii, ut videtur, parum constantis aut sobrii, dum ut, doctrinam novam conflaret مزج كلام التناسخية والمعتزلة بعضها ببعض (ut loquitur idem) Miscuerit inter se sententias eorum qui Metempsuchosin adstruunt, & Philosophorum, & Al Motazalorum, & in quascunque alias incideret, nec sacra Christianorum dogmata intemerata reliquit.

Ex iisdem Isa cognominatus Merdad] Ita certe in correctissimo duorum quibus usi sumus exemplarium, at legendum مرداد Mozdar, discimus ex Al Sharestanio, libro Al Mawakef, & Ebnol Kassaio. hic quod rerum mundanarum curae minus vacaret, سمي راهب المعتزلةlin. 4. Monachus Al Motazelorum, audiit.
Eo processit ut assereret ipsum Alcoranum creatum esse] vel modum excessit in adstruenda Alcorani creatione.l. 5.

page.notes: Arabic script is printed in a small, slightly blurred face; the Arabic words are transcribed as best read and may contain errors, especially in the line beginning "ان للخلق" and the long Arabic phrases on the second and third lines of the first paragraph. The bracket after "Merdad" and after "esse" marks variant readings in the printed text; no footnote text is printed for them. The margin note "c. de Nodamianis." may read "Nodamianis" or similar. Printed spelling "Alcoranum", "Monachus" and "Al Mawakef" left as printed. The Latin "Ita certe" and "Eo processit" lines follow the printed lineation.
